summary: Migrate authenticated legacy Wellman locks with pinned reusable workflow plans

delivery.outcome: Publish immutable 0.20.98 after protected review: explicit scaffold migration accepts only the exact committed legacy seven-file lock and supports digest-bound pinned reusable plans; ordinary native locks, tampering and unverified CI remain rejected.
nonGoals: No target repository changes in the Governance Hub
No managed hash edits, policy waiver, CI bypass or invented release evidence
No automatic replacement of target workflows

architecture.decision: Extend the explicit migration path with closed legacy lock validation against actual committed target bytes. Reuse the existing external future-CI plan without granting verification or publication. Keep first allocation and publication boundaries intact.

validation.evidence: Exact committed lock accepts; dirty, missing, symlinked, duplicate, extended, native and invalid-lock inputs reject before writes.

commands: Reusable plan CLI and real first-allocation regressions
validation.evidence: Migration plan projects future checks while target caller remains unchanged and unverified until material implementation.
